import numpy as np

def pick_and_stack_red_on_green():
    # Sample grasp pose for the red cube
    red_grasp_position, red_grasp_quaternion = sample_grasp_pose('red cube')

    # Get the pose of the red and green cubes
    _, _, red_extent = get_object_pose('red cube', return_bbox_extent=True)
    green_pose, _, green_extent = get_object_pose('green cube', return_bbox_extent=True)

    # Calculate the placement position
    green_center_z = green_pose[2]
    place_z = green_center_z + green_extent[2]/2 + red_extent[2]/2
    place_position = np.array([green_pose[0], green_pose[1], place_z])

    # Open the gripper before approaching
    open_gripper()

    # Go to the grasp position
    goto_pose(red_grasp_position, red_grasp_quaternion, z_approach=0.1)

    # Close the gripper
    close_gripper()

    # Lift the red cube to a safe height
    lift_position = red_grasp_position.copy()
    lift_position[2] += 0.2
    goto_pose(lift_position, red_grasp_quaternion)

    # Go to the placement position
    goto_pose(place_position, red_grasp_quaternion, z_approach=0.1)

    # Release the red cube
    open_gripper()
